testResults.name: focused-trust-and-projection-tests
testResults.command: uv run --extra dev pytest -p no:cacheprovider tests/thesis/knowledge/
testResults.result: 101 knowledge-layer tests: 21 new projection tests covering workspace trust overlay promote/demote round-trips with deterministic v1 JSON serialization, tier precedence (platform_policy > workspace_promoted > curated > untrusted, promotion never elevates or demotes platform policy), unknown-page rejection, AC1 default read access with an empty overlay, projection determinism (byte-identical rebuilds), JSON round-trip, citation fields (path, git revision, page version, source url, content hash, global and effective tiers), bounded excerpts, max_pages bounding, and the explicit NON_CANONICAL_GUARD asserting nexus/brain are not used and canonical is false (AC5); the 80 pre-existing corpus/search tests stay green
